edges.reason: advance uses msg.sender in incentivized modifier for reward minting
incentivized modifier mints reward to msg.sender
deposit uses msg.sender for transferFrom and staged credit
withdraw uses msg.sender for transfer and staged debit
bond uses msg.sender for balance changes
unbond uses msg.sender for balance changes
unbondUnderlying uses msg.sender for balance changes
purchaseCoupons credits msg.sender coupons and burns from msg.sender
vote checks balanceOf(msg.sender) and records msg.sender vote
mintToAccount may mint to msg.sender in incentivized path
couponRedemptionPenalty depends on block.timestamp modulo epoch period
epochTimeWithStrategy uses blockTimestamp for epoch math
Market.step uses epoch for coupon expiry
vote uses epoch for proposal timing
commit uses epoch for proposal timing
statusOf compares epoch to account deadlines
increaseSupply reads and updates redeemable balance
vote uses account balance as vote weight
withdraw modifier checks fluidUntil via statusOf
bond modifier checks fluidUntil via statusOf
unbond modifier checks fluidUntil via statusOf
unbondUnderlying modifier checks fluidUntil via statusOf
withdraw modifier checks lockedUntil via statusOf
vote modifier checks lockedUntil via statusOf
incentivized uses getPrice for DSD cost
redeemCoupons requires price greater than one
migrateCoupons checks and updates per-account coupon underlying
burnFromAccount calls dollar transferFrom and burn
redeemToAccount calls dollar mint and transfer
initialize calls mintToAccount for initial allocations
advance is wrapped by incentivized modifier
incentivized mints reward to msg.sender via mintToAccount
redeemToAccount calls dollar transfer for coupon amount
incentive local is minted via mintToAccount
external transferFrom before staged balance update allows reentrancy
external transferFrom before debt update allows reentrancy
external transfer before staged balance update allows reentrancy
external transfer before redeemable update allows reentrancy
external mint before redeemable update allows reentrancy
external mint before bonded update allows reentrancy
external burn before debt update allows reentrancy
delegatecall to new implementation can reenter state
Chainlink callback before reward minting allows reentrancy
oracle capture callback can reenter regulator step
